**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE SEVENTY-SIX RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS - **and vanilla's (§91b terrain: seven writers, one funnel, one bypass; §92 fog: every writer funnels through Unfog/Refog/SetAllFogged and all three raise MapEvents).** 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX - and its publish-time twin: A BUILD MESSAGE IS NOT PROOF THE RIGHT THING WAS BUILT; decompile the binary. 18 (§57a): **NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE** - grep version at rule 54. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE - selectable is drawable, and so is **highlightable** (§83). 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW - and §84.8's other half. 39 (§76): WINNING THE LAST WRITE DOES NOT SETTLE A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT THE TARGET. 40 (§75.h): A TRIPWIRE THAT FIRES BEFORE THE OBSERVER ATTACHES IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 (§77a): A STRUCT FIELD YOU NEVER SET IS A FEATURE YOU NEVER SHIPPED. 42 (§77b): THE DIRECTION A MOTION READS AS IS A PROPERTY OF THE THING, NOT OF THE ARRIVAL. 43 (§78): **DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION.** 44 (§78b): AN OFFSET APPLIED WHOLE ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT. 45 (§78d): **A DIRECTION OF TRAVEL IS NOT A DIRECTION OF ELEVATION.** 46 (§78d): **NON-UNIFORM SCALE x ROTATION = SHEAR.** 47 (§79): **A FOREIGN MOD'S CACHED CURSOR CELL IS AN ASSUMPTION ABOUT COORDINATE SPACE.** 48 (§81a): **A WRITE THAT IS READ BACK BY ITS OWN CALLER IS NOT A WRITE.** 49 (§0c): **A TEST THAT PROVES FEATURE A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT FEATURE B.** 50 (§82a): **TWO OF OUR OWN PATCHES ON ONE VANILLA METHOD CANCEL SILENTLY.** GREP OUR OWN `[HarmonyPatch]` LIST FIRST. 51 (§82b): **A FACTORY HAS USUALLY CONSUMED ITS INPUT BY THE TIME THE POSTFIX RUNS.** 52 (§83a): **AN OVERLAY MUST ASK THE SAME QUESTION THE CLICK WILL ASK, AND IT MUST NOT BE A QUESTION THAT WRITES.** 53 (§83c): **A PREDICATE PASSED IN IS CLOSED OVER THE ARGUMENTS THE CALLER ALREADY HAS.** 54 (§84a): **A CLEAN GREP IS NOT AN ABSENCE - SEARCH FOR THE CAPABILITY, NOT THE TYPE NAME.** 55 (§84.3): **"AFTER THE DUTY HAD ITS TURN" INCLUDES A FALLBACK JOB YOU WOULD NEVER CALL A REAL ONE.** 56 (§84.5): **WHEN YOU RANK CANDIDATES BY ONE COST AND FILTER THEM BY ANOTHER, THE RANKING FINDS THE FILTER'S BLIND SPOT.** 57 (§85a): **WHEN TWO SUBSYSTEMS EACH ANSWER "WHICH SIDE OF THIS THING", ONE OF THEM IS ABOUT TO BE WRONG.** 58 (§85b): **A PROPERTY OF THE ART CANNOT BE DERIVED FROM THE DEF.** 59 (§85.8): **`size` MUST BE MEASURED FROM THE DRAWING, NOT COPIED FROM `drawSize`.** 60 (§85.9): **MEASURE THE PIXELS; A DRAW OFFSET AND AN ART-OFFSET TABLE ARE THE SAME NUMBER TWICE.** 61 (§85c): **A COLOURED VERSION OF A GRAPHIC IS A DIFFERENT OBJECT, AND VANILLA HARD-CODES ITS TYPE.** 62 (§85d): **A TABLE OF FINISHED ANSWERS ROTS; STORE ONLY WHAT NOTHING ELSE OWNS AND DERIVE THE REST.** 63 (§85.14): **MEASURE A PATIENCE FROM THE EVENT IT NAMES.** 64 (§85.16): **A DIAGNOSTIC THAT IS OFF BY DEFAULT IS A DIAGNOSTIC THAT DOES NOT EXIST** - and its publish-time complement proven at w15: a diagnostic that is on by `#if DEBUG` only is ALREADY off for players; verify by decompile, not by deleting code. 65 (§85.17): **WHEN A DERIVED RULE IS RIGHT THREE TIMES OUT OF FOUR, THE FOURTH IS A DEFECTIVE INPUT.** 66 (§85.19): **A DESTINATION CELL DOES NOT CONSTRAIN THE SIDE IT IS ENTERED FROM.** 67 (§85.20): **AN EARLY RETURN THAT PRESERVES STATE MUST ASK WHO SENT THE NEW ORDER.** 68 (§85.22): **WHEN THE SAME 'EXCEPTION' IS REPORTED TWICE ON ONE DEF, IT IS THE DEF'S RULE, NOT TWO EXCEPTIONS.** 69 (§86a): **WHEN YOU SUSPEND A FOREIGN MOD'S DRIVER, YOU INHERIT EVERY REQUEST THAT DRIVER SERVED.** 70 (§87a): **AN OPT-IN CORRECTION APPLIED AT N CONSUMERS IS A DEFAULT APPLIED AT THE WRONG LAYER** - and §93.a is its flip side: once the correction IS the default, every foreign consumer that meant the RAW value is a new bug, and the fix is one more entry on the opt-out list, installed from the compat bridge when the type is foreign. 71 (§89): **A PROBE THAT ASKS FOR "THE" OCCUPANT CANNOT SEE A STACK.** 72 (§90): **A DESTINATION THAT NAMES A BUILDING OUTLIVES EVERY CORRECTION MADE TO THE ARRIVAL.** 73 (§89): **A PROBE THAT COMPUTES ITS OWN ANSWER IS NOT READING THE SUBJECT'S.** 74 (§91): **A PROFILER'S PERCENT COLUMN HAS A DENOMINATOR; NAME IT BEFORE QUOTING IT.** DPA's Percent is share of the INSTRUMENTED SUBSET (header ms/Frame names it), its flat list double-counts a postfix and the helper the postfix calls, and a run with `profilerDisarmedBelowFloor > 0` bills un-instrumented children to whichever instrumented parent still wraps them. The temperature-overhead claim died on the claimant's own screenshot once the denominator was named; the #404 "regression" (temp 175ms, biome 305ms) was 15x-only ticking + stacked profilers + 6 disarmed patches, refused as a diff. 75 (§94): **A LENGTH MEASURED ACROSS BANDS PRICES "NORTH" AS "UP".** Bands stack along +z, so a raw map-space subtraction between cells on different bands folds the band stride into the north-south term - never measure it; compare same-band points (project via `Translate`) or make the crossing a constant. The ground→3rd ladder detour was up to a full Slot of free discount for anchors north of the destination on multi-hop UP trips, the same term a PENALTY going down (accidentally correct), and invisible on single hops (same-band term clean). 76 (§94.g): **VERIFY THE WINNER, NOT THE FIELD.** When an estimate decides an argmax, real-cost the WINNING candidate and re-rank until the winner survives - candidates that never win are never paid for, so exactness costs O(winners), not O(field). Born the hour §94 v1 shipped: straight-line said 18 cells to the grand-stairs mouth, the pather's own probe said 105 around the compound wall, and the planner marched the pawn past nearer stairs. A straight line across a walled base is not a distance.

# 92. THE BELOW-VIEW FOG GATE — **SHIPPED w15; FIELD-VERIFIED #404 (user: "all the views were fine")**

Three per-frame below passes walked WHOLE-MAP lists whenever any band below the view existed - `DrawBelowPawns` (every spawned pawn, ending with `DrawBelowRealtimeThings` over every `DrawThings` entry), `Patch_ThingOverlays_ABBelow` (whole GUI-overlay lister group), `Patch_OverlayDrawer_ABBelowForbidden` (vanilla's overlay-handle registry). Each rejects per thing on fog - so when EVERY band below the view is fully fogged (undug-basement majority state) the walks provably produce nothing and are skipped whole. **Output-identical by implication: the gate's predicate implies the per-thing test each pass already applies.**

**92.a ZERO HARMONY - VANILLA EVENTS COVER EVERYTHING (rule 16).** Audit of 1.6 fog writers: `Unfog` raises `MapEvents.CellFogChanged(c,false)`; `Refog` per flipped cell; `SetAllFogged` raises `MapFogged`; `ClearAllFog` = per-cell Unfog; both `FloodUnfogAdjacent` overloads = Unfog + FloodUnfog; **`FloodFillerFog` takes `FogGrid_Unsafe` for READS ONLY - its Processor and expansion pass call `fogGrid.Unfog` per cell.** `ExposeData` swaps silently but verdicts are session-lazy → load self-corrects. Only a foreign mod writing `FogGrid_Unsafe` directly bypasses - which also breaks vanilla's own event consumers; accepted, tripwired. Subscription in `ABBandMap.HookFogEvents` from `FinalizeInit` (idempotent; delegate and component share the map's lifetime).
**92.b THE VERDICT MACHINE.** `byte[] fogVerdict` per band: 0 unknown → scan on next ask; 1 fully fogged; 2 has unfogged. **An unfog event on a verdict-1 band IS ITSELF PROOF it opened - flip to 2, no scan.** Refog-class resets to 0. Scans (`ScanBandFullyFogged` over `RectOfBand`) run ~once per band per session + after rare refogs. Spurious raises (vanilla raises unconditionally from Unfog) can only land on already-open bands → never cause rescans. Handler ~free while `fogVerdict` null. Fog only shrinks in ordinary play → "while undiscovered" optimization; undiscovered is the majority state of most bands, and the walks it kills are population-linear.
**92.c GATE + TRIPWIRE.** `AnyUnfoggedBelow(viewBand)` checks bands 0..viewBand-1, fails OPEN on any doubt. Wired at the top of the three passes, AFTER cheap band checks, BEFORE any list fetch and BEFORE `PushBelowMouse` (no pass, no mouse fiction). **Debug tripwire:** when the gate closes, every ~600 frames re-derive verdicts from the grid; mismatch → `Log.Error` "V2 fog-gate DRIFT" + self-heal open. `LogTransit`-gated = zero Release cost. Dangerous drift direction = missed UNFOG on a pristine band (gate wrongly closed = invisible below content); missed REFOGS merely leave the gate open = safe. **VERIFIED: below-pass rows gone from DPA in #404; zero DRIFT errors through a session including reveal + settings regen; user confirmed views.**
**92.d DELIBERATELY NOT GATED:** `ABBelowFlecks` (per-fleck-CREATION; handles upward mirrors; its down-mirror has NO fog check today - gating would CHANGE output); section layers (fog fan/air mask ARE how fog draws); `ABBelowSelectionDraw`'s bracket pass (tiny); `ABBelowMultiSelect` (event-driven).
**92.e HONEST SCOPE:** wins are surface-view-over-undug-below - most colonies most of the time - and scale with colony size. Does nothing for a colonized stack or sky-view-over-surface. **94.b THE PLANNER (v1, this window).** `HopDistances` (min-hop BFS) + `Consider` (greedy proxy) DELETED → `TryPlanFirstHop`: multi-source Dijkstra over anchor buildings, seeded at destination island(s), first crossing of the cheapest FULL chain returned. Nodes deduped via `AddNode` (§59: comp<0 anchors recorded index −1 - no walk, no crossing, no seed). Edges = pairs at `FlightCost = 7f` (≈90t hold+clip in walk-cells; > 2× LandingRadius diagonal so re-plans never regress - suffix-optimality replaces the old `farHops == hops−1` filter) + same-island walks. **NO DISTANCE IS EVER MEASURED ACROSS BANDS, BY CONSTRUCTION** (islands never span bands - comp ids encode band as `band*BandStride + local`; crossings are constants). Also fixed en passant: min-hop dominance (elevator pairs), destination-COLUMN proxy (split flights), Touch multi-seed (all approach islands compete; old shape ranked only inside the min-hop island's table). Dead `ChainCache` deleted. **FIELD-CONFIRMED in #434: every logged pick was straight-line-optimal, both directions, incl. Touch (BuildRoof→comp−1) and correct picks of each staircase when the destination sat above it.**

**94.c-94.f — v1 record (shapes/budget/residuals/verify recipe) SUPERSEDED where §94.g overlaps; still true: callers untouched (TrySegment, ABTransitVisuals tick-built preview, V2PathProbe/V2Spike), (near,far) contract identical, §85 approach machinery untouched, crossings UNDIRECTED (one-way links would need a direction check), fresh per-call allocations (no static scratch), FlightCost constant per crossing regardless of band span.**

**94.g VERIFIED EDGES (rule 76 born here) — the same-session field failure and its fix.** Run #434, within the hour: Athena at (68,284) ordered to (81,493) picked the grand stairs at (77,301) - walk-in ESTIMATE 18 cells, but the compound wall forced a ~105-node real path (the §89 watchdog's own probe measured it) straight past the stairs at (65,288) 4 cells away. Straight lines lie across walls; rule 56 in its purest form. Fix, three parts:
- **Winner verification loop.** Rank on estimates as before; then verify the WINNER's pawn-side leg (`from`→near, pawn-threaded `FindPathNow`, Touch) and - when the winner lands in a destination island, i.e. the single-hop case - its seed leg (far→`to`). Replace any lying term with the real octile-summed length (`RealPathLen`: cardinal 1, diagonal √2 - node COUNTS undercount diagonals), re-run the (tiny, in-memory) Dijkstra + re-rank, loop until the winner survives. Each slot verified at most once → terminates; `MaxVerifyRounds = 6` belt; `VerifyEpsilon = 0.5` suppresses Touch-vs-OnCell off-by-ones. NOT-FOUND probes keep the estimate (transient rebuild states) rather than condemning a candidate. **Candidates that never win are never paid for - exactness costs O(winners), not O(field).** Corrections trace as `PLAN: walk-in/seed ... corrected X -> Y` under LogTransit (rule 31).
- **Real cached mid-chain edges.** Anchor↔anchor walk edges (the legs winner-verification never reaches) price with `WalkEdge`: real path length cached per `ABBandComponents.Version` (the pre-existing public stamp whose banner already named "the wormhole chain cache" as its customer - the dead ChainCache was that orphan; ⚠ a duplicate accessor was the one build error this window). Cache key = order-normalized thingID pair, COMPLEMENTED for the forbid-aware partition. Pawnless PassDoors pathing by design (cache is shared; walls are the liars being caught; per-pawn nuance lives in the winner legs). In the reporting colony this is load-bearing: the battlement corridor between ladders is several times its crow-flies length.
- **Cheap mode.** `exact = pawn?.CurJob?.def != JobDefOf.GotoWander`. Wander commutes keep v1's all-straight-line behavior and touch neither pathfinder nor cache (rule 4). Everything else - orders, work jobs, the route preview (safe: routes build on TICK via TickRoutes, not draw; and our own `Patch_PathFinder_ABRejectCrossBandSync` waves same-band probes through, NotFound degrades to keep-estimate) - gets verified edges. Avoid-areas now weigh in exactly as far as they bend the real paths.
**HONEST RESIDUALS:** multi-hop chains whose winner is NOT destination-island keep straight-line SEED legs (their tops usually sit near destinations in stacked builds; revisit on evidence - the PLAN lines will name it); WalkCache recomputes after every region rebuild (construction-heavy sessions churn it; bounded by intra-island anchor-pair count); verification A*s are same-band and short but synchronous (tick-side only, budget = O(winners)).
